item.title: Ancient Egyptian pleasure boat discovered
item.description: Archaeologists have uncovered a rare ancient Egyptian pleasure boat off the coast of Alexandria, dated to the early first century AD. Measuring an impressive 115 feet, this “floating palace” matches the vivid descriptions of Greek historian Strabo, who famously wrote of revelers dancing “without restraint” on these opulent vessels.
